title: Deactivating one part says 1 part selected and 1 part updated
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test.
  • Start on the Inventory page, on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.
custom_steps:
1. Click the three-dot actions button (⋮) in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  2. Click Deactivate parts.
  3. Click the part A row.
  4. Click Deactivate on the dark bar.
  5. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • Bulk mode turns on.

Step 3:

  • The bar reads 1 selected.

Step 4:

  • The "Deactivate parts?" confirmation opens and reads "1 part selected."

Step 5:

  • A green message reads "1 part updated."
  • Part A leaves the Active list without a page reload, and bulk mode ends.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change), story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk)

  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Bulk change, every part changed | "{n} parts updated." ("1 part updated." for one) | Success toast, fades on its own”
  • S2-R12: “The deactivated parts leave the Active tab without a page reload.”
  • S2-R14: “When every ticked part changes, the mode ends and the selection clears.”
